title: On Earning a week of wages in three days
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：earn　|　正文 374 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 earn 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the coach ① earned a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② earns a week of wages in three days at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ earn a week of wages in three days at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ earned a week of wages in three days before — a line in the record for April 1958 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Earning a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ earn the trust of the whole street at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Earn the trust of the whole street at once and never mention it again.

By 1971 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ earns the trust of the whole street without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ earned a week of wages in three days again when nobody else would.

⑩ To earn a week of wages in three days, my mother said in 1976, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody earns a week of wages in three days at once again and somebody must earn a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 挣得（一般过去式 earned a week of wages in three days：1964 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 挣得（一般现在 earns a week of wages in three days：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 挣得（不定式 to earn a week of wages in three days：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 挣得（过去完成时 had earned a week of wages in three days：1958 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 挣得（动名词 earning a week of wages in three days 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 赢得（earn the trust of the whole street：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去赢得赢得整条街的信任）
G. v. 赢得（earn the trust of the whole street：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 挣得（后段两处：新来的队员照例 earns the trust of the whole street，而母亲又一次 earned a week of wages in three days）

answers.why: earn 意为“挣得”，1964 年教练不图一句谢挣得三天挣下一周的工钱，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 earned。
earn 意为“挣得”，自那以后教练二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 earns。
earn 意为“挣得”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯挣得三天挣下一周的工钱”，此处为不定式 to earn a week of wages in three days。
earn 意为“挣得”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1971 年之前就有人挣得过，故用过去完成时 had earned。
earn 意为“挣得”，教练说“挣得三天挣下一周的工钱这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 earning a week of wages in three days 作主语。
earn 意为“赢得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去赢得赢得整条街的信任”，should ever 之后用原形 earn the trust of the whole street。
earn 意为“赢得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻赢得赢得整条街的信任（earn the trust of the whole street at once），以后再也不要提起。
earn 意为“挣得”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例赢得赢得整条街的信任，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 earns。
earn 意为“挣得”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢挣得三天挣下一周的工钱，用一般过去式 earned 叙述。
earn 意为“挣得”，结尾那句是母亲 1976 年的话：要挣得三天挣下一周的工钱，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，教练不图一句谢挣得三天挣下一周的工钱；球场里每一个队员都说这是头一回。（earned a week of wages in three days）
多年以后，教练仍二话不说地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（earns a week of wages in three days）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯挣得三天挣下一周的工钱这件事本身。（to earn a week of wages in three days）
早在 1958 年就有人挣得三天挣下一周的工钱，四月那天赛事记录上的一行字就是证据。（had earned a week of wages in three days）
教练说过，不图一句谢挣得三天挣下一周的工钱这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（earning a week of wages in three days 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻赢得赢得整条街的信任，以后再也不要提起。（earn the trust of the whole street，祈使句）
answers: In 1964 the coach earned a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the coach still earns a week of wages in three days at once without being asked.
My mother said later that to earn a week of wages in three days at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had earned a week of wages in three days long before 1971, and the line in the record for April proves it.
Earning a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Earn the trust of the whole street at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 earn 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the coach earned a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach earns a week of wages in three days at once whenever the field asks.
Earning a week of wages in three days without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever earn the trust of the whole street at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field earns the trust of the whole street without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother earned a week of wages in three days again, and the field remembered that half.
